title: State change
description: Single source of truth for content/state/*.json. The generator emits against this file; apply-state.yml reads against the same one. It describes only the DELTA an entry makes to the world — the entry row itself is derived from the Markdown file, never restated here. Seed (0000.json) and thread reviews (NNNN_review.json) use the same shape with no entry beside them.

day.description: The day this change belongs to. 0 is the seed, which precedes every entry.

entities.description: Entities introduced by this change. Only places that matter become entities — somewhere Ebner works, stops, or will return to. Scenery passed on the way stays in the prose. A new destination may bring its containment chain with it (system, planet, station are three rows for one place), and that is not proliferation.

parent.description: Containment, for places: moon inside planet inside system. Must not form a cycle.

travel.description: Hops made on this day, in order. The first hop's `from` must equal the previous entry's location; the last hop's `to` must equal this entry's location.

threads.description: Thread lifecycle operations. Ceilings are guarded, not declared here: at most 5 active, at most 3 recurring.

facts.description: Facts opened or closed by this change. A fact is never edited: an upgrade or a change of circumstance closes the old one and opens a new one, which is what valid_from/valid_to are for.

id.description: Stable id so a later entry can close this fact without matching on its prose.

kind.description: world_rule marks the single rule a civilisation lives by — the one taken from a rational premise to its absurd end. Surfaced separately when assembling context so the writer does not contradict it. Everything else is general: the ship's condition, money, what someone owes, what a place is like.

fragments.description: Fragments to index in Vectorize. Index sparingly — at most ~5 per entry — to stay inside the free tier.

sketch.description: Prompt for the sketch image, or null when the entry has none. The pipeline generates it; nothing is supplied by hand.
